note: Test reply for the living world: weather by day, sights, whereabouts, an invented person, an urgent letter with two branches, an enemy commander and thread updates. Illustrative. Also: the Diarium, winter quarters and the steward on money.

changes.title: A crowded week
changes.briefing: Rain over Vienna. Recruiting parties in the streets; the court watches who is seen with whom.

whereabouts.doing: deep in talk by the gate

reports.title: A sum that does not agree
reports.text: Your Excellency asked for the chests. The day book shows a remittance from Linz entered twice.

reports.title: The Breslau magazine
reports.text: Wallis asks whether to move the Breslau magazine to Neisse now, before the roads close. He needs an answer today.

urgent.prompt: Harrach waits for your answer before he writes to Wallis.

options.label: Move the magazine to Neisse at once

letters.title: The wagons are rolling
letters.text: The first wagons left for Neisse this morning.

remarks: Wallis moves the Breslau magazine on your word.

options.label: Let Wallis decide on the spot

remarks: Wallis was left to decide about the magazine himself.

reports.title: Quiet at Glogau
reports.text: All quiet at Glogau. The roads are deep in mud.

guidance.known: A hussar patrol saw no Prussian troops near the town.
guidance.suspected: Mud will slow any march from Brandenburg as much as ours.
guidance.explain: A patrol reports what it rode past; it does not see beyond the next wood.

canon: A remittance from Linz was entered twice in the Hofkammer day book.
hidden.chronicle: Test chronicle: a week of rain; Kessler finds a double entry; Wallis asks about the Breslau magazine.

decisions.knows: The Emperor is dead; Vienna is in mourning and short of money.
decisions.decides: Keeps his counsel and orders the regiments readied, quietly.

purse.income: rents from the Carinthian estates, late
purse.debts: a note to a Vienna banker, due at Christmas

items.head: From the Hofburg
items.text: Her Majesty received the homage of the court in deep mourning. The ministers of the late Emperor are confirmed in their offices.

items.head: From Berlin, the 8th
items.text: The King has reviewed several regiments at Potsdam and is said to be in excellent health.

items.head: Prices
items.text: Wheat at the Hof market stands higher than last week.

household.purse: The Carinthian rents are late, and the banker asks politely when his note will be met.

staffBriefing.changed: The day book has turned up a Linz remittance entered twice, and Wallis writes that all is quiet at Glogau, though the roads are deep in mud.
staffBriefing.stakes: If the chests hold less than the Hofkammer reckons, your figures before the Conference will be wrong, and Harrach will be glad to say so.
staffBriefing.attention: Whether to have the day book checked against the Linz receipts, and what Wallis is to do before the roads close.

guidance.known: One entry appears twice in the day book.
guidance.suspected: A clerk's slip, not a theft; nothing yet shows which.
